description.en: A short story about Ali’s life. The first chapter shows how he used his nine lives. The second chapter reveals his parents who have passed away. The third chapter is about the continuous chain of love between animals; there is some gender identity mistakes in this one by the author. The fourth chapter highlights the past when he was with his mother. The fifth chapter is about the friend he had when young. And the last chapter is about the shadows which somehow feel like he is in his own world.

This is a story about fulfilling a promise. Have you forgotten how to live? The gods who have protected us for thousands of years will teach you what life is. A story about love and protection begins.

Ke Lim got a doll with the same name as her for a present from her dad, who found it on a business trip in Germany. When she took her new doll to go play at the park, she meet and become fast (best) friend with a boy at the park because of the glass shoes. However, he later have to move away soon and he make a promise with her that he will come back and find her. She gave him one of the glass shoe tied with a ribbon from her doll with her name on it. so that he will not forget her. She came to the same park everyday after that to wait for him… Will he come back to see her again? Or may be he already…. And, why does Qiang Shu remind her so much of that boy? She must stop her attraction to Qiang Shu. Qiang Shu cannot be that boy since Qiang Shu is a GIRL!?  
  
Second part of the Agreement of the Glass Shoe trilogy.

description.en: A twist of fate took the life of legendary hitman, Wu Qi. Strangely, he was not even aware of the identity of his killer. It was then that the Killing Intent System revealed itself to him. Wu Qi and the system made a pact— as long as he completes the tasks he was assigned with, he would get a chance at resurrection and uncover the truth behind his death. Just like that, Wu Qi, with the help of the Killing Intent System, travelled through time and space to put an end to enemies who are intent on killing others. Despite shouldering the burden of unpardonable sins, he decides to commit himself to saving the universe.

description.en:
Mixing cocktails at a level beyond anyone else in the world, a sommelier, the one known as the liquor god Li Jie Dong. He died at the age of thirty in order to taste the recently excavated wine from the Han Dynasty.

When he awoke, he found himself in the world of the Five Element Continents as Ji Dong the little beggar. In this place, there was a special occupation known as the Yin Yang Spiritual Masters who control the the 10 elements of the sexagenary cycle. These bizarre 10 elemental techniques could make anyone gasp in amazement. Each and every Yin Yang Spiritual Master has their own Ying Yang crown that is condensed by one’s own attribute.

Due to the abundant love the people held for their wine and liquor, bartenders gradually gathered together to form a guild. This guild is named the Bartender Guild, and is respected by all.

---


**Note:** Starting with ch. 81, the manhua switches to the long strip format. MangaDex decided to follow Inkr's decision and just keep it split.

She is a Chinese manhua artist. She is best known for creating the comics Zi Bu Yu and Chang Ge Xing, and five million copies of her works have been sold as of 2018. Her art has been noted for its classical style, and have been met with positive reception in both China and Japan. In 2008, she won the Gold Prize in the girls’ category of the fiction section, the Fifth OACC Golden Dragon Award Original Animation & Comic Competition, the biggest one in China of its kind.

Her interests had included painting and comic-reading since she was a child, and she was eventually inspired to make her own comics in high school. She published her first work, titled Cheng Zhang, in the Beijing Cartoon magazine, receiving an encouraging, handwritten reply by her editorial teacher. After graduating from university, she moved to Beijing and briefly worked in advertising before quitting to focus on her own comics. During this time, she became engrossed in drawing, seldom leaving her apartment as she lived on a modest income.

description.en: Seventeen year old Qianchun, gets lost in a place deep in the mountains when his classmates pull a prank. Later, he finds out that there is a ghost story about a hotel in the mountains, about a mother and her son…

Julie’s family is very poor, and since she’s plain and ugly, as her sister has told her time and time again, she does most of the chores in her house. By accident, she meets the Yee family while trying to get her plane back from a tree in their yard. She meets the family again a year later and is adopted into their family. Soon she becomes a pawn between Mr. Yee’s new wife and his oldest son Ryan, both of which will use Julie as a means to hurt one another. Can Julie survive her new life till she’s of legal age to leave?

Amidst the bustling crowd and the hurried footsteps, I heard a voice - an angelic voice. They always say that God always favors the good and the kind, and that you reap what you sow. I don't know if meeting him signals the start of my good or bad luck, though. A relationship without any actual love might be an easy thing to maintain as long as both sides remain amicable with each other... At least, that's what I thought. However, when...

It's another idol competition!
A new star will be born!
When the show took the theme of choosing the new Ziwei Star, it caught the attention of the actual Ziwei Emperor in the heavenly courts, and he decides to descend to the mortal realm to enter the competition himself. Soon afterwards, who will become the next "Ziwei Star" is the talk of the town!

In this competition, it will be a three-way battle between the management's choice vs the people's choice vs the choice of heaven. A fierce battle for the coveted C spot is about to begin!

(Source: Dongman, translated)

Note: Season 3 is a new storyline featuring a new main character. Most platforms have Season 3 as a separate entry from seasons 1&2.

Yun Su, a principled regent, lived by a code of honor that demanded the repayment of bot kindness and vengeance. His greatest debt of gratitude was owed to none other than his destined nemesis, the Martial Regent. In a twist of fate, even as he was on the verge of death, the Martial Regent chose to protect and save his life. Perplexed by this act of selflessness from the man of noble status and immense wealth, Yun Su found himself at a loss for how to properly reciprocate. With no other means at his disposal, he decided to marry him.
description.es: Como Regente Civil, a Yun Su le gusta devolver la Amabilidad con Bondad y la Venganza con Venganza. Lo más importante que debía hacer era devolverle su destino a su viejo enemigo, el Regente Marcial Xia Hou Chuan, el pequeño tonto que quiso protegerlo y salvarlo antes de morir en su primera vida. Sin embargo ese pequeño tonto era noble, rico, amable, honesto y leal, por lo que Yun Su realmente no sabía por dónde empezar. “No tengo nada con que pagarle.... solo puedo darle mi vida y cuerpo a cambio”. El Poderoso Gong el Regente Marcial x El Renacido Shou el Regente Civil.
